note: Grounded repaint v3 2026-10-21: one coherent attic kitchen, single tiled floor; everyone stands, sits on a stool/chair or works at a real oven, stove, table or grill at true scale; the stingray lives in a seafood tank; nothing floating, no rows. Feminine words left of the roof post, masculine right. Only exit: the stairwell going DOWN to the main kitchen (an upper floor never leads straight outside). Skylights are not exits.

items.label: la purée
items.scene: A grey stingray in the kitchen tank pulls a disgusted face, 'PEW!' (pew-RAY), at the bowl of creamy MASHED POTATO set down beside its glass.

items.label: la moutarde
items.scene: A 'MOO' TART (moo-TARD): a smiling cow face piped on a tart covered in yellow MUSTARD, its mouth open in a big moo.

items.label: la vanille
items.scene: Like English 'vanilla' minus the end, said vah-NEEY: a girl on a stool holds a long dark VANILLA pod under her nose like a moustache and breathes in its sweet smell.

items.label: la salsa
items.scene: Like English 'salsa', with the beat on the end (sahl-SAH): a bowl of chunky red SALSA waits on its stool beside a pair of maracas, ready to dance.

items.label: la cuisson
items.scene: A quizmaster in a bow tie turns his quiz hourglass at the brick oven, 'QUIZ ON!' (kwee-SOHN): how long is the roast's COOKING time?

items.label: la bouillabaisse
items.scene: A fisherwoman cheers 'BOO-YAH!' (boo-yah-BESS) over her big pot of BOUILLABAISSE fish stew while a red crab peeps over the rim.

items.label: la gastronomie
items.scene: Like English 'gastronomy', but it ends in ME (gahs-troh-noh-MEE): a proud old chef with a medal gives himself a thumbs-up, 'ME!', as he carries a tower of FINE FRENCH DISHES.

items.label: le préparatif
items.scene: Like English 'preparations', but ending in TEEF (pray-pah-rah-TEEF): grandpa chews his pencil between his TEETH as he works down his long list of PARTY PREPARATIONS.

items.label: l'ingrédient
items.scene: Like English 'ingredient', said an-GRAY-dyahn: eggs, a sack of flour and a block of butter lined up on a GREY slate board, the INGREDIENTS ready.

items.label: gastronomique
items.scene: Like English 'gastronomic', but ending in MEEK (gahs-troh-noh-MEEK): a MEEK little mouse shyly lifts the silver dome off a tiny GOURMET plate.

items.label: le barbecue
items.scene: Like English 'barbecue', said bahr-buh-KYOO, ending in QUEUE: grandma flips a long QUEUE of sausages lined up on her smoking BARBECUE grill.
